title: Maple Mono CJK Build Config
description: JSON config consumed by scripts.cjk.config.config_from_json(). Output paths, font naming, temporary paths, and incompatible glyph behavior are derived from locale_name and are not customizable.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI for editor validation.

locale_name.description: Compact locale suffix used to derive output paths and font names, for example CN, JP, TC, KR, or HK.

path.description: Input CJK glyf or CFF2 variable font.

masters.description: Source axis locations keyed by Maple output weights. Keys must be exactly 100, 400, and 800.

outline_mode.description: Expected source outline format. auto detects glyf or CFF2 from the source font.

drop_tables.description: OpenType tables removed from the source subset before merge work.

ranges.description: Unicode ranges copied from the source font. Empty or omitted falls back to the default CJK ranges.

filter_encoding.description: Optional Python codec name used to keep only codepoints encodable by that encoding, for example cp932.

exclude_feature_codepoints.description: When true, removes source glyphs whose codepoints are already supplied by the Maple feature font.

target_advance_width.description: Target advance width for imported CJK glyphs before downstream Maple width handling.

x_scale.description: Horizontal scale applied to imported CJK outlines.

y_scale.description: Vertical scale applied to imported CJK outlines.

x_shift.description: Horizontal shift applied to imported CJK outlines.

y_shift.description: Vertical shift applied to imported CJK outlines.

italic_angle.description: Italic slant angle used when generating italic CJK base fonts.

path.description: Absolute path, repository-relative source/ path, or path relative to the JSON config file.

masterLocation.description: Source font axis coordinates for one Maple output weight. Must include wght.

oneOf.description: A single codepoint, a hyphen or '..' range, or one pyftsubset-style unicode range entry.
